32190035.clinical_problem: automated bone age assessment for skeletal maturity in children

33123034.exclusion_reason: fMRI pilot study of face-processing hemispheric lateralization in children versus adults; conventional statistical comparison, no AI/ML component

32090205.dataset_size: 11 CT exams for training; 20 low-dose datasets for evaluation

38166332.headline_result: Dice score 0.91 (EDV) and 0.86 (ESV); ICC>0.97 for ventricular volumes; satisfactory segmentation in 68% of 475 unseen exams, minor adjustments needed in 26%

38703545.headline_result: segmentation accuracy comparable to more complex state-of-the-art networks using only 6% of their parameters, running at 31.13 frames per second on a Jetson Nano (7x faster)

38900281.model_description: A national UK survey study (not a specific model) of children's and young people's views on the use of AI in their own medical imaging, including AI for detecting bone fractures on x-ray, assessing attitudes toward AI accuracy, speed, and the need for human oversight.
38900281.headline_result: 71.3% wanted to know an AI tool's accuracy; 66.1% said accuracy was more important than speed; 64.3% wanted human oversight; 42.7% felt AI would be more accurate than humans at finding bone x-ray problems
